newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Diagnostic Labs changes name.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Diagnostic Labs changes name.

text.p: U.S. Diagnostic Labs Inc said it amended its name to U.S. Diagnostic Inc from Wednesday but the company stock symbol "USDL" would remain unchanged.
The stock trades on the National Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotation system.
U.S. Diagnostic provides radiology services focussing on the acquisition, operation and management of multi-modality diagnostic imaging centers and related medical facilities in the United States.
